collate_atomic_data_list: collate a list of AtomicData objects into a single batch using data_list_collater
collate_with_neighbors: collate AtomicData objects and compute neighbor counts from edge_index for each data point
collate_to_dict: collate a list of AtomicData objects and return the batch as a dictionary of tensors
collate_with_otf_graph: collate AtomicData objects with otf_graph enabled to skip neighbor computation when edge index is missing
review_data_list_collater: review the data_list_collater function to understand how AtomicData batches are created and neighbor counts computed
